definitions.explanation: The area along the side of a road or route. Commonly used to describe spectators, shops, or scenery along a parade route, marathon course, or similar path.

examples.japanese: {沿道|えんどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{沿道|えんどう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{声援|せいえん}→声援：10153_seien⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{送|おく}られた→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Loud cheers were sent from the roadside along the marathon route.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{沿道|えんどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{並木|なみき}→並木：00302_namiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}る→咲き誇る：11834_sakihokoru⟧。
examples.english: When cherry blossom season arrives, the trees along the road bloom beautifully.

notes:
USAGE:
{沿道|えんどう} specifically means the area along the sides of a road or route. It is very commonly used in news coverage of parades, marathons, and processions to describe where spectators gather. Compare with ⟦{道端|みちばた}→道端：28126_michibata⟧ (roadside), which is more casual and refers to the immediate edge of any road, while {沿道|えんどう} suggests a longer stretch along a specific route.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {沿道|えんどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観衆|かんしゅう}→観衆：22893_kanshuu⟧: spectators along the route
- {沿道|えんどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line the roadside
- {沿道|えんどう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{声援|せいえん}→声援：10153_seien⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to cheer from the roadside
- {沿道|えんどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧: residents along the road
